title: FLA asset storage (bitmaps & sounds in zip)
description: Improve FLA zip to store BitmapItem/SoundItem data URIs as separate binary entries (assets/bitmaps/<id>.png, assets/sounds/<id>.mp3) instead of inline in document.json. Update saveFla to extract asset data and write as zip entries; update loadFla to reconstitute dataUri fields from zip entries. Keeps document.json small and avoids base64 bloat. Only touches packages/core/src/fla/. See docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
